environment.description: Staging deployment on the same ECS cluster. LaunchDarkly environment key points to the 'staging' project environment where both flags ('enable-custom-templates' and 'enable-beta-rendering') have their targeting rules DISABLED and the fallthrough value is set to false. The LD relay proxy running as a sidecar container caches flag state locally with a 0-second polling interval (streaming mode), and the SDK is configured with the 'staging' environment SDK key via AWS Secrets Manager (arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789:secret:ld-staging-sdk-key). The fallback-on-error behavior in the middleware also defaults to false. Note: the application code, container image, and deployment manifest are identical to production — only the LD environment SDK key injected at runtime differs.

config.runtime: Node.js 18 on ECS Fargate (same task definition)
config.ld_flag_enable_custom_templates: targeting OFF, fallthrough: false, off-variation: false
config.ld_flag_enable_beta_rendering: targeting OFF, fallthrough: false, off-variation: false
config.ld_relay_proxy: sidecar container, streaming mode, 0s poll interval
config.network: Internal ALB, security group allows only VPN CIDR
config.note: Flag state is deterministic: no targeting rules exist in staging LD environment, all evaluations return default (false)
